newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hopewell seen deciding CEPA sale next week - paper.
newsitem.headline: Hopewell seen deciding CEPA sale next week - paper.

text.p: Hopewell Holdings Ltd is expected to announce its decision on selling part or all of its stake in Consolidated Electric Power Asia Ltd next week, the Hong Kong Economic Journal said.

A total of six consortia from Europe, the United States and South East Asia had made purchasing proposals and Hopewell had appointed financial consultant Peregrine Capital to vet the proposals, the paper quoted market sources as saying.
This might lead to a sale agreement involving up to a maximum of more than HK$14 billion if Hopewell decided to sell all of its 60.4 percent stake in CEPA, it said.

Earlier this month Hopewell said a number of independent third parties had approached the company relating to the possible acquisition of part of or all of its shares in CEPA but that no decision had been made so far.
Hopewell officials could not be reached for comment.
